comparisons.peer_topic: Customer Collaboration and Product Development Support
comparisons.peer_summary: AMD collaborates with customers to define product features and employs application engineers to assist with system design, testing, and qualification. This support aims to improve time-to-market and foster long-term relationships.
comparisons.comparison: Both NVDA and AMD explicitly employ technical teams (application engineers/solution architects) to provide pre-sales support for system design, testing, and qualification. NVDA specifies that these teams assist partners in optimizing infrastructure for generative AI, LLMs, and enterprise applications, working directly with CSPs and developers. AMD similarly employs application engineers to assist customers in designing, testing, and qualifying system designs incorporating their products, aiming to improve time-to-market and foster long-term relationships. While both provide this technical pre-sales assistance, NVDA's disclosure is more specific about the AI workload focus (generative AI/LLM training/deployment), whereas AMD's is broader regarding product features and performance timing.

sentences.text: We also employ a team of application engineers and solution architects to provide pre-sales assistance to our partner network in designing, testing, and qualifying system designs that incorporate our platforms.
For example, our solution architects work with CSPs to provide pre-sales assistance to optimize their hardware and software infrastructure for generative AI and LLM training and deployment.
We also employ application engineers to assist our customers in designing, testing and qualifying system designs that incorporate our products.

We believe that our commitment to customer service and design support improves our customers' time-to-market and fosters relationships that encourage customers to use the next generation of our products.
